verdict.rationale: LegalOS says it offers 'Fixed-fee pricing, not hourly billing,' but the evidence states it publishes no actual prices on its site. Its USCIS fee calculator estimates government filing fees only, not LegalOS's own service fees. That makes it an adjacent feature, not a published price list for the provider's services.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see real prices before I talk to anyone — published flat fees or a priced service menu on the provider's own site
